thag3.2:1.1: Pañcāhāhaṃ pabbajito sekho appattamānaso, vihāraṃ me paviṭṭhassa cetaso paṇidhī ahū: || ||
thag3.2:2.1: nāsissaṃ na pivissāmi vihārato na nikkhame na pi passaṃ nipātessaṃ taṇhāsalle anūhate. || ||
thag3.2:3.1: tassa mevaṃ viharato passa viriyaparakkamaṃ, tisso vijjā anuppattā, kataṃ buddhassa sāsanan ti. || || Paccayo thero.
